summary: A Depth subscription on a perpetual: the book before any ticker goes out with its levels padded to five; a ticker after it does not refresh the Depth frame on the desktop (audit P-07), while the web publishes the merged book again.

notes: A book after a ticker cannot be pinned yet: the desktop's frame would carry the earlier ticker's receipt time as ltt (see the ltt deviation of ticker_quote_ltp_mode_change).

deviations.reason: The web's Delta adapter sends data.mode its own way (the subscription mode number, or no key); the desktop sends its label (ltp, quote, full). Lead rule 2026-11-09: this follows each broker's own web adapter (lane wire's per-broker dialect switch; bk-a sets the entry in phase B).
A depth frame keeps ltp, which the SDK's Depth callback reads: 0 before the symbol's first ticker; the web's merged cache has no ltp until a ticker came.

The desktop sends the sum of the visible book levels as total_buy_quantity / total_sell_quantity; the web names the same sums totalbuyqty / totalsellqty. Delta sends no totals: a sum of five levels is not the exchange's total (lane wire: decide the names; the decoder should not present a sum as the total).
The web's name for the summed bid sizes; the desktop sends total_buy_quantity. An alias for lane wire, or a web defect if the sum is dropped.

Delta's ob_l2 has no order counts: the web's levels carry price and quantity only, the desktop's carry orders 0 (an invented zero; the 1.0.6 known limitation). Both pad a short side to five zero levels, which lane wire should settle for every broker (no padded book).
